tool.name: sincei scFilterBarcodes
tool.description: detect and filter cell barcodes in a BAM file
tool.command: @PREPARE_SINGLE_BAM@ scFilterBarcodes --bamfile input.bam --outFile '$barcodes_out' @CELL_TAG_CMD@ --binSize $binSize --minCount $minCount #if $whitelist: --whitelist '$whitelist' #if str($minHammingDist) not in ('', 'None'): --minHammingDist $minHammingDist #end if #end if #if str($minMappingQuality) not in ('', 'None'): --minMappingQuality $minMappingQuality #end if #if $rankPlot: --rankPlot rank_plot.png #end if @EXCLUSION_CMD@ @THREADS@

param.label: Barcode whitelist
param.help: Single-column file of expected barcodes. If set, detected barcodes are matched against it.

param.label: Hamming distance for whitelist matching
param.help: Maximum Hamming distance allowed when matching barcodes to the whitelist. Higher values slow down detection considerably. Only used with a whitelist.

param.label: Minimum number of non-zero bins
param.help: Report only barcodes with reads in at least this many bins.

param.label: Minimum mapping quality
param.help: Only reads with at least this mapping quality are considered.

param.label: Plot barcode rank (knee) plot
param.help: Plot the number of non-zero bins per barcode against the barcode rank.

tool.help:
**What it does**
`scFilterBarcodes` scans a BAM file for cell barcodes (stored in a BAM tag, `BC` by default) and reports how many genomic bins each barcode has reads in. Barcodes can be matched against a whitelist, allowing some Hamming distance, and filtered by a minimum number of non-zero bins. This is typically the first step to find which barcodes correspond to real cells.
-----
**Inputs**
- A coordinate-sorted BAM file with a cell barcode tag. - Optionally, a single-column whitelist of expected barcodes.
**Outputs**
- A table of detected barcodes with their bin count and whether they passed the filters. The `selected` barcodes can be used as the whitelist (`--barcodes`) for the other sincei tools. - Optionally, a barcode rank ("knee") plot.
**Note:** the rank plot cannot be drawn when all barcodes have the same count. @HELP_FOOTER@
